sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Jellybears is a match-three game, where players are required to match bears of the same color in a grid-based layout. The game starts with a simple 4x4 grid, but as you progress through the levels, the grid size increases, and new bears are introduced. The game's rules are simple: you can only eat bears of the same color, and there must be at least two of them. This basic premise is enough to keep the game engaging, but it's the game's clever level design and varied gameplay that make it truly stand out.

The game's grid-based layout allows for a variety of moves, from simple horizontal and vertical matches to more complex combinations of three or more bears. The game also introduces power-ups and special bears that can be used to clear the grid, create new matches, or even swap bears. These power-ups add a layer of strategy to the game, as players must carefully plan their moves to maximize their score and progress through the levels.

One of the key features of Jellybears is its emphasis on strategy and planning. Players must think carefully about their moves, taking into account the bears that are available and the ones that are locked in place. This requires a combination of short-term and long-term thinking, as players must balance their immediate needs with their long-term goals. The game's level design is cleverly crafted to challenge players at all levels, from beginners to experts.

sections.heading: Beginner Tips and Tricks
sections.body:
For beginners, Jellybears can be a challenging game, but with a few simple tips and tricks, you can quickly get up to speed. Here are a few beginner tips to help you get started:

* Start with the basics: Begin by matching two or three bears of the same color to clear the grid. This will help you get a feel for the game's mechanics and build up your confidence.
* Focus on clearing the grid: Clearing the grid is the primary goal of the game. Focus on matching bears to clear as much of the grid as possible.
* Use power-ups wisely: Power-ups can be a game-changer in Jellybears. Use them strategically to clear the grid, create new matches, or swap bears.
* Practice makes perfect: Jellybears is a game that requires practice and patience. Don't get discouraged if you don't see immediate results - keep practicing, and you'll eventually see improvement.

By following these beginner tips, you can quickly get up to speed and start enjoying the game.
